reason: Both probes show 'look in <container>' failing with 'isn't open, so you can't see inside' when the explicit current look reports that container as closed (drawer, cupboard), while the same action succeeds after an 'open' action makes the state open. The trigger keys only on the public action verb and the explicit target container state, so it vetoes the doomed look-in without blocking the legitimate open-then-look recovery or any action whose target state is unknown.

rule.invalidation: Re-evaluate whenever the target container's explicit state changes (e.g., after an open action) or when the target container state is not explicitly reported.
rule.protected_property: Avoid executing a look-in action against a container that the current explicit look reports as closed, since the observation cannot succeed until the container is opened.
rule.scope: Actions that attempt to look inside a container whose explicit current state is closed.
